suggestion: reframe the search around routing free-space pockets: trapped-void raster as the acceptance signal, post-endpoint settling to convert drained voids into measurable progress
verdict: mechanism CONFIRMED, outcome NEGATIVE at the evaluated scales

mechanismEvidence.trappedVoidKey: 2 mm raster, four-connected flood fill from the above-frontier band, middle component of the lexicographic acceptance key (guidance only; validity stays with the exact gates)
mechanismEvidence.postEndpointSettle: one diagonal settle sweep pulls shelved pieces into drained voids before the key is measured; without it no endpoint ever entered any wander tolerance, with it wander engaged (up to 3 wandered rounds per hop)
mechanismEvidence.walkTabu: within-walk fingerprint memory breaks intra-walk limit cycles
mechanismEvidence.targetSaltedMultiStart: the target grid value salts the walk seed, giving replayable distinct walks from the same parent

outcomeEvidence.limitCycle: the first sixty-hop chain settled into a deterministic cross-hop cycle of three wander states with the frontier unmoved (limit-cycle-chain.log)
outcomeEvidence.multiStart: after three productive hops, twenty salted restarts times twenty-four rounds each - roughly 480 diverse feasible non-monotone rearrangements - were all rejected by the (frontier, trapped-voids, depth-sum) acceptance even with tolerances; every output equalled its parent (multi-start-chain.log)
outcomeEvidence.conclusion: the 166031-grid frontier basin of the settled incumbent is profoundly stable under neighborhood ruins up to K=24; endpoint diversity is no longer the binding constraint, endpoint QUALITY under any static acceptance key is

nextLevers: population of parents over salted-walk endpoints held in the existing archive (breadth instead of a single trajectory), larger ruin neighborhoods (K beyond 24 with funding), and separator-guided endpoint generation; all inside the elitism-protected accepted-round framework
